'''''Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel and the fifth volume in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' series. It was written by [[Karen Traviss]] and first published by [[Del Rey]] in hardcover on [[May 29]], [[2007]]. The first paperback edition was released on [[April 29]], [[2008]] and includes the novella ''[[Boba Fett: A Practical Man]]'' by Traviss.
